deleted.title: Recover deleted files from a USB stick
deleted.metaDescription: Deleted something from a USB stick? Here is how to scan it safely and get files back with free tools.
deleted.summary: USB sticks keep deleted data until new files overwrite it. Stop saving to it.
deleted.riskNote: Read-only scans do not change the stick.
stopFirst: Do not copy new files onto the stick.

steps.title: Unplug it
how: Unplug the drive and put it somewhere safe.

steps.title: Plug into a computer
how: Windows: open **File Explorer** and look for the drive in the left list. Mac: open Finder.
Type `photorec /d recovered` only if the guide tells you to, then press Enter.

steps.title: Run PhotoRec
steps.detail: Select the stick and save results to your computer.
how: Windows: open **File Explorer** and look for the drive in the left list. Mac: open Finder.
Type `photorec /d recovered` only if the guide tells you to, then press Enter.
Wait until the progress bar stops. This is safe to leave running & check later.

steps.title: Review files
how: Windows: open **File Explorer** and look for the drive in the left list. Mac: open Finder.

deleted.callPro: If the stick is not detected at all, consider a professional.

faq.a: Often names are lost with PhotoRec; TestDisk may keep them.
